title: Keel: Next.js SaaS Starter Kit
description: Production-ready Next.js SaaS starter with auth, billing, teams, and admin tooling built in. Ship your product in days, not months.
longDescription: Keel is a production-ready Next.js 16 SaaS foundation so you stop rebuilding the same boilerplate on every new project. Auth (sessions and OAuth), Stripe subscriptions and webhooks, teams with roles and invites, an AI SDK with a credit system, and Postgres with Drizzle migrations, wired up and ready to scaffold with one command.
priceNote: One-time purchase, 3 license tiers from $199 to $899
contentSummary: AI SDK with a credit system

previewItems.label: Scaffold
previewItems.text: npx create-keel-app scaffolds a full Next.js 16 + TypeScript foundation with auth, billing, teams, and a real dashboard already wired together.

previewItems.label: Billing
previewItems.text: Stripe subscriptions and webhooks are already integrated, not left as a TODO you have to wire up yourself before you can charge anyone.

whatsInside: Next.js 16 + TypeScript foundation, type-safe end to end
AI SDK with a built-in credit system
A real dashboard, not a placeholder screen

previewTips.label: Solo tier
previewTips.tip: A one-time source code snapshot. Right fit if you're shipping a single project and don't need ongoing updates to the kit itself.

previewTips.label: Studio tier
previewTips.tip: Adds private repo access with ongoing updates via git pull, so your foundation keeps improving after you've built on top of it.

previewTips.label: Agency tier
previewTips.tip: Everything in Studio, plus multi-project use and white-label rights, for building on Keel across multiple client or product codebases.

whoIsItFor: Founders who want to skip SaaS boilerplate and start on the actual product
Freelance developers who build SaaS MVPs for clients and want a faster starting point
Small teams shipping one active SaaS project (Studio tier)
Agencies building on the same foundation across multiple client projects (Agency tier)

faq.q: What's the difference between the three tiers?
faq.a: Solo ($199) is a one-time source code snapshot for a single project. Studio ($349) adds private repo access with ongoing updates via git pull, best if you're actively shipping one project. Agency ($899) includes everything in Studio plus multi-project use and white-label rights.

faq.q: What's actually included in the codebase?
faq.a: A Next.js 16 + TypeScript foundation with auth (sessions and OAuth), Stripe subscriptions and webhooks, teams with roles and invites, an AI SDK with a credit system, and Postgres with Drizzle migrations.

faq.q: Do I need to be an expert to use it?
faq.a: You should be comfortable with Next.js and TypeScript. Keel gives you a wired-up foundation, not a no-code tool, you're still writing your product on top of it.

faq.q: Can I use this for client projects?
faq.a: Yes, on the Agency tier, which covers multi-project and white-label use. Solo and Studio are licensed for a single project.
